The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. Next, the adult learner considers Right to Petition, Fair Trial, Liability, and Negligence. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. Finally, the adult learner considers Jurisdiction, Precedent, and Statute.
